meaning: The clocks that the values of three scaffold-recordings builds belong to: agricultural science (no dip and no difference between the game and the simulator after its staged start), agricultural science with backed-up belts (no difference between the game and the simulator), and the inserters moved_open names for chemical science with a shared foundry. Each build is named as in scaffold-recordings.game.test.ts, its config by the ConfigPaths key; `clock_sha256` is the sha256 of the identity (clockIdentity) of the clock the generator selects for it. The game test refuses to run on another clock and scaffold-recordings-clock.generation.test.ts checks the selection (the two agricultural science builds on the generations of agricultural-science.generation.test.ts and clock-belt.generation.test.ts), so a clock that moves is found before those values are taken for the new clock's. The original chemical science shared-foundry values were recorded on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 on one output swing per cycle (the previous hash, taken on 2026-10-23; no original clock recording was kept). Since targeted searches, shifted swings (2 output swings per cycle) wins with fewer windows at equal wake-ups and recovery. Fresh Factorio 2.1.21 recording on 2026-11-01: 256 in all 103 periods, no comparison issues beyond the unchanged named exceptions; sulfur and advanced-circuit cuts plus blocked output-clock conditions each recover within the simulator's 4-period bound. The previous exact stable clock remains offered. Both agricultural science builds select batched swings (5 output swings per cycle), one clock for both, with windows on the two inserters that take eggs out of the loop into the science biochamber and, since a later change that day, on the two inserters of the loop itself: recorded on it on 2026-10-24, 400 in every one of 74 periods from the staged start, and no difference between the game and the simulator in what any inserter or machine moved (the clock with only the first two on windows, and the same clock with all four always on, were recorded the same day with the same results, 400 in every period from the staged start and from the prepared one; the 2-swing clock before that).

previous.why: Targeted shifted search now runs past a stable short clock; equal wake-ups and recovery, 36 ranked windows instead of 48. Both exact clocks remain stable. The shifted clock passed fresh Factorio 2.1.21 scaffold and three-disturbance checks on 2026-11-01.
